scope: Direct Legendre expansion, n>=61, 24<=precision(T)<=53, finite frozen audit with independently stable/indexed references and distinct represented nodes. Higher precision uses its separately frozen GST criterion.
coefficient_origin: Unchanged November13 n61 operational engineering coefficients, now supported by direct stable-formula rounding rationale and a precision-dependent omitted-polynomial bound; not fitted to fresh errors.

selector.limitation: Bounds compare omitted finite stored polynomials in exact arithmetic. Full expansion/table/asymptotic and working-rounding errors remain engineering-model components checked independently.

gates: native requested working type/precision with separate Float32 floor controls
distinct ordered nodes and positive normal weights
failure_policy: Invalid reference or unresolved context is inconclusive. Structural/model/required-normal-loss failures remain failures; coefficients and cases must not be altered to fit observations.
limitations: No generic fixed-ulp promise across algorithms or formats
No relative accuracy assertion for unrepresentable weights
No extension of Float64 coefficient tables above53bits
higher_precision_n61: Also retain November13 boundary screen: node <=4*eps*max(abs(x),1/n), normal-weight-relative <=(8*n+8)*eps. Use the stricter of this screen and sharedGST.
